title: 6.2 Ways to Travel
unit_outcome: Name places and transport, explain a current destination, complete a trip, follow directions, ask for help, choose a service and check its times.
goal: Identify transport and connect it to familiar journeys; explicitly practise a bus, a train and an airplane.
grammar_function: Begin with a familiar school journey by bus. Compare train and taxi for the town visit, then walking for a nearby library. A clearly introduced second travel situation extends the same pattern to an airplane and a boat; it is not a magical bus–plane–boat trip.
prerequisite: Units 1–5 and the earlier Unit 6 lessons in the displayed course sequence.
speaking_outcome: Identify transport and connect it to familiar journeys; explicitly practise a bus, a train and an airplane.
